page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Top: running head and page number. Continuation of a letter's paragraph; date line; centred heading "EPIST. LXXIII."; italic argument summary; centred italic heading "A MONSIEUR" with the addressee and greeting; letter text beginning with a large initial. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: benevolis multis officiis saepius defen-sam & auctam hoc beneficio magis ac magis habebit sibi devinctam & devotam, amplissimamque Jesu Christo, cui nos omniaque nostra consecramus, sustentatae familiae suae mercedem reporta-bit. Deus & Reip. Christianæ, & literariæ quâm diutissime & felicissime con-servet.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXXIII.
J. Morinus Lud. Capello quid Buxtorfio rescripserit recenset, alia nonnulla quæ ad Rabbinorum libros pertinent.
main_text.p: ILy à quelque Jour, que M. vostre fils me rendit, une lettre de vostre part, par la quelle vous me remerciez de quelques services, que je vous avois rendus, il n'e-stoit

page.notes: The initial "I" of the letter is a large initial joined to "Ly" (set as "ILy"). Long s rendered as s; u/v corrected; "qvâm" read as quâm, "qve" as que, "qvelqve" as quelque. "n'é-" with line-end hyphen and "stoit" on the next line, read as n'e-stoit. Argument summary treated as a level 2 heading above the letter. Greeting lines are italic paragraphs, not headings.
